raw_response:
I've been on this land 45 years. I don't read much — I go by what my hands know and what my neighbors do. Let me think it through.

My 8.5 mu — I put about 6 mu to wheat then maize after, like always. The other 2.5 mu I keep in cotton like I've done for many years. My son says cotton price is not what it was, but I know cotton. I don't change.

For wheat — I plant in October after the maize comes off. I buy 2 bags of erantong (DAP) for each mu to put down with the seed, that's the way. Then in spring when it greens up, I spread 1 bag of urea per mu. Maybe a little more if it looks yellow. I water 4 times — once before winter so roots hold, then at jointing, at heading, and when grain is filling. If spring is dry I water 5. For spray, aphids come every year and sometimes rust on the leaves, I spray 2 times, maybe 3. I use the improved seed the dealer in town sells — jimai I think they call it. Last year I got about 1000 jin per mu (500 kg), that's normal.

For maize after wheat — I don't plough, just rotary and drill in. I use hybrid seed, zhengdan or xianyu, whichever the dealer has. One bag of compound fertilizer (the 15-15-15) per mu at planting, then one bag of urea per mu when it's knee-high. I water once at tasseling if no rain. Spray once for the borer. I get 1100-1200 jin per mu (550-600 kg) usually.

For cotton — this is more work. I plough the land in spring, use Bt hybrid seed (Bt cotton, so bollworm is less trouble now). I put 1 bag DAP and half bag potash per mu at planting because cotton wants potash or bolls drop. Then urea side-dress 1 bag per mu at squaring. I water 3 times from the well. Still I spray 5-6 times — aphids, mirids, spider mites, the bollworm still comes sometimes. I pinch the tops in July. Get maybe 220 kg seed cotton per mu.

I do not change much from last year. Too risky. My neighbors do about the same.
